gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ysabeau-office: Wide-open, pen-free lettering with real swagger: Bellota Text leads the page. Ysabeau Office, a modern sans with open-ended curves, carries paragraph after paragraph without any fuss or strain on the eye.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kodchasan: Distinctive from the first glyph, Bruno Ace draws everything with a ruler. Bruno Ace is best at showy, open-counter display lines, while Kodchasan is best at staying clean, with terminals that hang open.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-lxgw-marker-gothic: Rigid, wire-wound lettering with attitude to spare, courtesy of Bruno Ace. Next to it, LXGW Marker Gothic feels looser and softer, its wide-open c and gently varying strokes easing the heading's constant line.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-meera-inimai: Meera Inimai is approachable, its open-ended curves given plenty of room to breathe. Under Bruno Ace's ruler-drawn headings, text keeps moving easily line after line, with a constant, blueprint-like stroke that never tires.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-mingzat: Contemporary through and through, Mingzat follows Bruno Ace, whose round forms look bent from wire, with curvy, unclamped letters. Paragraphs flow smoothly down the page, the curves never feeling cramped or tight.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-national-park: Bruno Ace draws every letter with a ruler, constant-width and showy. National Park supplies rounded, pressure-steady letters with a clearly open side, giving the heading's rigid line a softer partner.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-canadian-a: Hard-edged, wire-cut shapes with real presence, courtesy of Bruno Ace. Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal follows with a sans whose curve ends stay open, giving the display letters room to stand out.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ojuju: Approachable and contemporary, Ojuju carries a faint thick-thin rhythm, like crayon on rough paper, beneath Bruno Ace's hairline-free headings. Reading on feels warm and unhurried, with wide s curves barely curled in.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-pt-sans: PT Sans, with c forms that read as open arcs, sits comfortably beneath the one-tip simplicity of Bruno Ace. Page after page, its text stays approachable and tireless to follow.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-tasa-explorer: Ruler-straight swagger with no brush-style swell anywhere, thanks to Bruno Ace. Bruno Ace is built for loud, expressive statements, while TASA Explorer does the quieter job, its curves ending like brush strokes lifted early.
